definitions.explanation: Spending by a company on facilities, machinery, and equipment intended to expand or improve production capacity — a standard term in business and economic reporting.

examples.japanese: {設備投資|せつびとうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やす→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧。
⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{設備投資|せつびとうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れている→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: This year the company is focusing on capital investment in its factories.

examples.japanese: ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}く→悪い：00908_warui⟧なると、⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{設備投資|せつびとうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}える→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧がある。
examples.english: When the economy worsens, companies tend to hold back on capital investment.

notes:
{設備投資|せつびとうし} is the standard business and economics term for spending on facilities, machinery, and equipment to expand or improve production.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {設備投資|せつびとうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to make a capital investment
- {設備投資|せつびとうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やす→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧/⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧: to increase/decrease capital investment
- {設備投資|せつびとうし}⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧: capital investment plan

USAGE:
Frequent in economic news alongside indicators such as GDP and corporate earnings, where {設備投資|せつびとうし} trends are read as a sign of business confidence.
